verdict.rationale: Groq's docs explicitly instruct developers to reuse OpenAI client libraries by just swapping api_key and base_url to https://api.groq.com/openai/v1, and this is corroborated by a live probe showing the OpenAI-style /v1/models endpoint responding in the expected JSON error format. Chat completions, streaming, tool-use, and structured outputs are all documented against this same OpenAI-compatible surface, supporting drop-in provider switching mid-workflow. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation from a real agent framework that switching providers requires zero code changes, and clarity on any OpenAI parameters/features that are NOT supported (full parity claim not verified end-to-end).
